name: Author Kit
author: Author Kit Team

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/author-kit/ or install it via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to the “Author Kit” section in the admin menu to begin setup.
  4. Customize templates via Appearance > Customize > Author Kit.
sections.faq:
Can I assign multiple authors to one post?

Yes, the plugin supports co-authors for individual posts.

Does it support schema markup?

Yes, schema.org markup is included for author bio and archive pages.

Can I disable the author box on specific posts and for specific user?

Yes, you can easily display or hide the Author Bio Box for any post or user with just one click

Is it compatible with my theme?

The plugin is compatible with most modern WordPress themes like Astra ,Blocksy, Divi , etc.
You can easily check your capability status by going to settings page in Author Kit Dashboard

Is multisite supported?

Currently, the plugin is intended for single-site WordPress installations.

Are pages supported?

The author box is only displayed on single post pages by default.

Does Author Kit provide any shortcodes, widget or blocks?

Author Kit is newly launched and is continuously improving, as of now, Shortcodes, widget or blocks are not provided but with the increase in user base we are planning to add more power features and templates.

Does it support RTL and translation plugins?

Yes, it supports RTL layouts and is compatible with WPML and Polylang.

I want to say thanks?

Thank you for using Author Kit!
If you find it helpful, please consider leaving a 5-star review and sharing it with others. Your support helps us grow and improve.
sections.description:
Empower your WordPress Authors: Author Kit help you manage multiple author effortlessly with user-friendly and productive dashboard

AUTHOR KIT #1 WORDPRESS AUTHOR MANAGEMENT PLUGIN

Since the evolution of AI-written content and Google penalties on AI-generated content, it is time to empower human-written content on your website by streamlining your author management with Author Kit.
Author Kit’s mission is **Productivity for Authors **. It helps managing users, post and authors from the single dashboard without wasting time navigating and display the data in an Ajax based tables, No more reloads or delays.

MAIN FEATURES

  1. User-friendly data table for Users, Posts, and Authors
  2. Get real-time online status for every user and connect efficiently
  3. Block and unblock users with just one click to secure the dashboard
  4. Manage author profiles and add information like bio, job title, email, company, and much more
  5. One-click Gravatar and local avatar switch
  6. Pre-made templates for Author Bio Boxes, Author Archive Pages, and Post Author Meta Bylines
  7. Fully customizable with your beloved WordPress Customizer
  8. Full display control per user and per post to display or hide bio box
  9. Easily add multiple co-authors to posts with one click — even guests and subscribers
  10. Create guest user accounts with one click
  11. All major social platform integrations — add social icons including new trending platforms like BlueSky and Mastodon

Notes

Author Kit is beginner friendly— no code required. It’s a full-featured, seamless, and enjoyable experience designed to save your time and reduce cognitive load with a focused and user-friendly UI.
We started our journey as bloggers and content creators. As we grew, we realized there was no beginner-friendly plugin to manage authors, especially for blogs, magazines, or multi-author sites. So, we learned to code and built Author Kit — a tool we wish we had when we started.
This plugin is for every WordPress user who manages blogs and collaborates with multiple authors.
We’re committed to making Author Kit even better with your help. Let’s together build the most intuitive and powerful author management experience for WordPress.
We’re always open to your feedback and will continue to release new features based on the needs and requests of our users.
— The Author Kit Team
